resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code, used as equivalent to VASP.

resources.notes: DFT engine for relaxations, phonon force constants, band structures, and work functions.

resources.name: Phonopy

access.notes: Phonon calculation package for DFPT post-processing.

resources.notes: Used with Quantum ESPRESSO to compute phonon dispersions and detect imaginary modes.

resources.name: SSSP Pseudopotential Library

access.notes: Public library of pseudopotentials (efficiency set) required for lanthanide atoms.

resources.notes: Provides PBE pseudopotentials for Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, C, F, O, H.
